Uses sitemap URLs exclusively without following page links

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, mapUrls } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await mapUrls(engine, url);
  console.log(result.urls?.length);
}

void main();
```
